description:
Validate vault files against the adulting schemas.

Usage: lint [--schemas DIR] [--quiet] [PATH ...]

Args:
  PATH  files to validate; zero or more; with none given, walks the whole vault

Flags:
  --schemas DIR  schemas directory (default: the schemas bundled with the package)
  --quiet        print nothing; report by exit code only

Examples:
  []
  ["threads/Projects/Northwind.md"]
  ["--quiet"]

Notes:
  Each violation prints as <path>:<line>: <message>, with an absolute path. A file that is not valid UTF-8 is reported as 'file is not valid UTF-8' (other commands skip such files silently).
  Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: violations found. Exit 2: no schemas could be loaded.
